title: Mission 3 Assessment: Subject–Verb Agreement
subtitle: Answer all 10 senior detective questions covering Odisha Class X and Assam concordance rules. Review your choices before submitting.

questions.questionText: Compare the opening articles carefully: 'The number of solar lamps in our village _____ increased steadily, while a number of households _____ installing rooftop panels.'
questions.explanation: 'The number of + plural noun' denotes ONE single figure/count (singular 'has'), whereas 'a number of + plural noun' means 'many/several' (plural 'are').
questions.learningObjective: Distinguishing 'the number of' vs 'a number of'

questions.questionText: Read the water conservation report: 'Two-thirds of the rainwater _____ stored safely, and two-thirds of the tanks _____ already full.'
questions.explanation: With fractions and percentages, check the noun AFTER 'of': uncountable 'rainwater' takes singular 'is', while plural countable 'tanks' takes plural 'are'.
questions.learningObjective: Fractions and percentages with countable vs uncountable nouns

questions.questionText: Examine both collective noun clues: 'The selection committee _____ unanimous in its decision, whereas the debate jury _____ divided in their opinions.'
questions.explanation: 'unanimous in its decision' shows the committee acting as ONE unit (singular 'was'); 'divided in their opinions' shows individual members disagreeing (plural 'were').
questions.learningObjective: Collective nouns as a single unit vs individuals

questions.questionText: Trace the relative pronoun antecedent: 'Meera is one of the Class 10 students who _____ selected for the national science exhibition.'
questions.explanation: Inside 'one of the students who...', the relative pronoun 'who' refers to plural 'students', so the clause verb must be plural ('have been').

questions.questionText: Select the accurate sentence combining 'the + adjective' and plural-form titles:

options.text: The brave is remembered with pride, and Gulliver's Travels are an exciting book.
The brave are remembered with pride, and Gulliver's Travels is an exciting book.
The brave was remembered with pride, and Gulliver's Travels were an exciting book.
The brave is remembered with pride, and Gulliver's Travels is an exciting book.

questions.explanation: Odisha Class X Rules 14 & 15: 'The + adjective' denoting a class of people ('The brave') takes a plural verb ('are'), whereas one book title ('Gulliver's Travels') takes a singular verb ('is').

questions.questionText: Choose the verb matching the nearer subject: 'Not only the coach but also the young sprinters _____ preparing for the state meet.'
questions.explanation: With 'not only...but also', the verb agrees with the NEARER Subject ('the young sprinters' → plural 'are').

questions.questionText: Compare 'with' and single-determiner titles: 'The poet and freedom thinker, with his followers, _____ addressing the gathering.'
questions.explanation: One 'The' ('The poet and freedom thinker') names ONE person, and phrases introduced by 'with' do not alter the first Subject's singular number → 'is'.

questions.questionText: Which sentence uses the uncountable noun 'furniture' and 'Many a' accurately according to Odisha Class X & Assam rules?

options.text: The classroom furniture are brand new, and many a student admire it.
The classroom furniture is brand new, and many a student admires it.
The classroom furnitures are brand new, and many a student admire it.
The classroom furniture is brand new, and many a students admires it.

questions.explanation: 'furniture' is an uncountable singular noun ('is'), and 'many a + singular noun' ('many a student') takes a singular verb ('admires').

questions.questionText: In a Class 10 board exam, which verb is the formal standard choice for: 'Neither of the laboratories _____ unlocked yet.'?
questions.explanation: Formal grammar and board exams expect singular 'is' after 'neither of + plural noun'. (Odisha Class X Rule 7a notes plural may occur in casual conversation, so know the formal rule clearly.)
questions.learningObjective: Formal vs conversational caveat for 'neither of'

questions.questionText: Diagnose the agreement error in this notice: 'The police is investigating why five thousand rupees were missing from the trophy fund.'

options.text: 'police' takes plural 'are', while 'five thousand rupees' as one sum takes singular 'was'.
Only 'five thousand rupees' is wrong; 'The police is' is correct.

questions.explanation: Both verbs were flipped! Always-plural 'police' requires 'are investigating', whereas one total sum of money ('five thousand rupees') takes singular 'was missing'.
questions.learningObjective: Diagnosing flipped SVA errors in complex sentences
